$comment: New Mateu project — the SINGLE description of what every front door generates (IntelliJ New Project wizard, VS Code 'Mateu: New Project', the scripts/new-project.mjs CLI; the Maven archetype is built from the same starters). The templates ARE the starters (starters/<dir>), compiled and booted by CI on every change; this file only says how to turn one into a project of your own. Two engines apply it and are kept identical by the shared cases in cases.json: io.mateu.ijp.newproject.MateuProjectGenerator (Kotlin, IntelliJ) and src/newProject.ts (TypeScript, VS Code).
The first choice is the AUTHORING flavour; it names the starter directory (`starter`, where ${runtime} is the chosen runtime) and the runtimes it is offered on (none = no runtime question).

Steps, in order: (1) copy starters/<starter> minus `exclude`; (2) drop the language's `sampleFiles` unless the flavour keeps the sample (keepsSample && sample != 'empty'); (3) apply `unmount` to the kept sample when unmountsSample (the class stops being an @UI mount: routes.yaml binds it instead); (4) copy the overlays (starters/generator/overlays/common — its `gitignore` is renamed to .gitignore, so packaging never treats it as an ignore file —, then overlays/<language>/<overlay>): the language's `overlays`, the flavour's (`overlays[sample]`, else `overlays['*']`) and the renderer's (`rendererOverlays[renderer]`) — an overlay file replaces the starter file at the same path; (5) for a flavour with `pages`, render the chosen page templates (new-file-kinds.json pageTemplates) into specsDir, add the sample's route when the flavour unmounts it, and expand the marker lines `# __ROUTES__` of routes.yaml and `# __MENU__` of app.yaml into their entries (removed when there are none); (6) apply `replacements` (in order, variables expanded in `from` and `to`) to every text file, then `renames` to paths, and move packageDir to sourceRoot/<package path>.

Variables: ${groupId} ${artifactId} ${package} ${packagePath} ${namespace} ${appTitle} ${version} ${nugetVersion} ${pypiVersion} ${renderer} ${rendererArtifactId} ${runtime} ${starter}. `version` is the latest io.mateu:mateu-bom release on Maven Central (versionMetadataUrl), falling back to the <mateu.version> pinned in the starters.
